theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_sd_zero_neg
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity (0 : GeometricCurrentOn U k) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U k, IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity (0 - X)) ∧ (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (G : Set (Euclid P)), (0 - X).massOn G = X.massOn G) ∧ ∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (ω : TestFormOn U k) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → X.mass ≠ ∞ → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ≤ s) → |X ω| ≤ s * X.mass.toReal
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
